description: The release gate for a report built with build_report: facts, hand-typed numbers, exhibits, links (online: true requests them), the page (up to date, disclaimer, nothing external, no raw markup), vintage, each source's notices and audit hooks, clearances, secrets, style, chartbook structure, the method record, benchmarks and the replication package; rerun: true replays every exhibit recipe and fact. Returns one line per check, the failures with their messages (verbose: every check), and "AUDIT PASSED" only when nothing fails.

rerun.description: Replay every exhibit recipe and recompute every fact

verbose.description: List every check, not only the failures

name: audit_report
title: Audit the report
